test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

She was within a __hair's breadth__ of winning.
solution:
The correct answer is "**narrow margin**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the given idiom 'hair's breadth' is **"**
